QUOTE: Rust, JS/TS, shell and CMake files have no doxygen front end. Their extensions are routed in `harvest.py` and `synth.py` instead. I did not trace how each of those harvesters enumerates files...
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says doxygen filters by FILE_PATTERNS and that other languages go through separate harvesters, but it never states the file-reaches-index-only-if-readable point, never names the parse-built front end as a filter, and never mentions binary classification.
